title: Synchronization of Unbalanced Dynamical Optimal Transport across Multiple Spaces
summary: Many biological systems are observed through heterogeneous modalities, requiring transport models that couple dynamics across spaces while allowing mass variation. To address this challenge, we introduce Unbalanced Synchronized Optimal Transport (UnSyncOT), a novel dynamical framework that synchronizes transport-reaction flows between spaces via either geometric embeddings (Monge type) or Markov kernels (Kantorovich type). For both cases we prove that UnSyncOT can be reduced to a single-space problem: the Monge model becomes a Benamou-Brenier problem with a metric-modified kinetic energy,…
